moduleTitle: Travel and tourism, including places of interest

questions.examTip: Structure your description in three parts: what you see, an opinion, and a personal link — this shows range beyond simple description.
questions.modelAnswer:
Sur la photo, je vois une famille sur une plage de sable, avec une vieille ville et un château en arrière-plan. Le temps a l'air magnifique et l'endroit semble très touristique. À mon avis, les vacances à la plage sont idéales parce qu'on peut se détendre tout en visitant des sites culturels intéressants.

(English translation: In the photo, I can see a family on a sandy beach, with an old town and castle in the background. The weather looks beautiful and the place seems very touristy. In my opinion, beach holidays are ideal because you can relax while also visiting interesting cultural sites.)

Useful phrases: en arrière-plan; l'endroit semble...; tout en + gerund
questions.question: Describe this photo of a family on a sandy beach with a historic old town and castle visible in the background. Say what is happening, what the place might be like, and give your opinion on beach holidays.

questions.examTip: Prepare flexible phrases for the unexpected question in advance; you cannot predict it exactly, but a stock structure (opinion + reason + example) will fit almost any topic.
questions.modelAnswer:
— Bonjour, je voudrais réserver une chambre pour deux personnes, s'il vous plaît.
— Est-ce que le petit-déjeuner est inclus dans le prix ?
— (Question imprévue) Nous allons rester trois nuits, du vendredi au dimanche.

(English translation: — Hello, I would like to book a room for two people, please.
— Is breakfast included in the price?
— (Unexpected question) We are going to stay three nights, from Friday to Sunday.)

Useful phrases: je voudrais réserver; est-ce que... est inclus ?; nous allons rester
questions.question: Role-play: your teacher plays a French hotel receptionist. You must (1) say you would like to book a room, (2) ask about breakfast, and (3) answer an unexpected question about how many nights you are staying.
Describe an imagined photograph showing travel, tourism and places of interest. Include a person, an action, a place, an opinion with a reason and one past or future detail.
questions.modelAnswer: Sur la photo, on voit... Au premier plan, une personne est en train de... Je pense que c'est ... parce que... Récemment, j'ai... / À l'avenir, je...
questions.examTip: Use exact evidence, varied time frames and justified opinions; check negative wording and verb accuracy.

questions.question:
Read aloud, then discuss: « L'été dernier, je suis allé au bord de la mer en train. Nous avons visité un vieux château près de notre hôtel. L'année prochaine, je voudrais découvrir une grande ville française. »
Give the main message, one agreement, one disagreement and a personal extension.
questions.modelAnswer: The main message is: Last summer, I went to the seaside by train. We visited an old castle near our hotel. Next year, I would like to discover a large French city.. Je suis d'accord avec... mais je pense aussi que... Pour ma part...

note.summary:
Travel and tourism, including places of interest
Key vocabulary
- la réservation
- une chambre
- un aller-retour
- un hébergement
- se situer

Revision focus
Practise present, past and future forms while discussing travel, tourism and places of interest. Build answers with justified opinions and precise examples.

Exam technique
- Spot time markers and negatives before answering.
- Use parce que/car to justify an opinion.
- Check adjective agreement, verb endings and whether the task asks for French or English.
